groups.firstCause: Filter count text uses theme-dependent foreground colors plus opacity over Nutri-Score and muted filter backgrounds, producing serious WCAG 1.4.3 failures in light and dark themes.
groups.proposedDisposition: Correct the semantic Nutri-Score foreground recipe and count styling without excluding Axe; prove light and dark contrast with focused component and browser coverage.

groups.firstCause: The product now truthfully renders the heading 'Start by choosing 2–4 products to compare'; the test still expects the retired 'Select 2–4 products to compare' copy.
groups.proposedDisposition: Update the heading assertion to the current semantic role and copy; do not change product copy to satisfy the stale test.

groups.firstCause: The broad /Manual/i button locator matches both the exact 'Manual' mode control and the distinct 'Enter Barcode Manually' recovery action when camera fallback is present.
groups.proposedDisposition: Target the exact Manual mode control by role and accessible name, without positional locators or UI behavior changes.

groups.firstCause: The Sign Up button correctly remains disabled until Turnstile succeeds; the local-only E2E tests attempt submission without a deterministic challenge token.
groups.proposedDisposition: Install a local in-page Turnstile API stub and local verification response for signup E2E only; retain production security behavior and hosted-egress blocking.

groups.firstCause: The functional fixture persisted Polish locale after cross-country tests; the filter helper looks only for an English placeholder even though the rendered combobox is correctly named 'Szukaj produktów'.
groups.proposedDisposition: Locate the search combobox inside its search landmark using its supported English or Polish accessible name; do not reset valid locale state or use positional selectors.
